name: School's Out Summer Day Camp
operator_name: School's Out, South Burlington School District
description_short: The South Burlington School District's summer day camp for children finishing kindergarten through 3rd grade, held at Rick Marcotte Central School and Orchard Elementary School, 8am to 5:30pm. Days mix a reading block, art, STEM, gym and outdoor time, with two or three field trips each week.
refund_policy_summary: Withdrawing with less than two weeks notice means paying that week in full. The $50 deposit per child per week is non-refundable and non-transferable.
notes: 2026 registration closed and all programs filled. Grades: the page says children currently in kindergarten to 3rd grade (2025 to 26), recorded here as entering 1st to 4th grade. $285 a week, $280 for a sibling, plus a $50 deposit per child per week. Families with full state child care funding pay no deposit; those with 50% or more subsidy pay none, under 50% pay $25. Bring lunch and snacks, a swimsuit and towel. No camp July 3.
